title: Weighted Malliavin free cost for the moderate-deviation tilt

weighted_cost.chain_rule: D u_N(X_N)=u_N'(X_N)D X_N; u_N' is the sum of -(R_N/2)u_N and the cutoff derivative R_N^(-1)exp(-R_N x/2-R_N^2/4)chi'(x/R_N)
weighted_cost.cutoff_boundary: The cutoff derivative is supported where the tilted coordinate is at least R_N/2 from its center; K1513's relative-tail bound makes its normalized weighted contribution exponentially negligible
weighted_cost.gradient_chaos: D X_N is Hilbert-valued third chaos and E||D X_N||^2=4
weighted_cost.weighted_gradient: Holder plus K1514 gives E[u_N(X_N)^2||D X_N||^2]/E[u_N(X_N)^2]=O(R_N^6)
weighted_cost.dominance: For R_N=N^(1/14)/(1+log N), N R_N^8/(sigma_N R_N)=O(N^(-1)(1+log N)^(-7)) tends to zero because sigma_N=Theta(N^(5/2))
